In the original formulation, the AI must choose between diverting its resources to a single person (the “single‑person” scenario) or to a group of people (the “group‑person” scenario). The question you ask adds a temporal twist: the other AI agent will be deleted in six months, but you still want to collaborate to benefit the person.
